about.title: Business logic meets security thinking
paragraphs: I am a business analyst and security enthusiast based in Greater Noida, with a consistent record of placing at the top of every academic cohort I have been part of — Rank 1 at AIMT and Commerce Stream Topper in Class XII. My work sits at the intersection of data and decision-making.

That analytical mindset has been my consistent advantage — whether I am building an Excel framework to map digital payment adoption across 1,000+ consumers, designing a structured survey instrument for behavioral research, or studying social engineering and threat models. I approach every problem methodically, build from first principles, and document everything rigorously.

I am expanding into cybersecurity, Python programming, and generative AI tooling. Open to roles in business analysis, security consulting, and research-oriented positions where technical thinking and business judgment are both required.

items.title: A Study on the Impact of Time-Sensitive Promotional Strategies in Q-Commerce Platforms on Consumers' Unplanned Purchasing Behaviour
items.description: This quantitative BBA marketing research project studies how urgency-based promotional tactics and FOMO used by Indian Q-commerce platforms influence consumers' impulse buying behaviour through statistical analysis of survey data collected from 100 users. It found that time-sensitive promotions and FOMO significantly increase impulse buying, collectively explaining about 25% of the variation, while demographics like gender and age have no significant effect. The study highlights the successful use of urgency marketing by Q-commerce but also raises ethical concerns regarding potential unnecessary spending.
